descl:
Máscara respiratoria que cubre toda la cara. Reutilizable y de bajo mantenimiento.
Puede trabajar con filtros de partículas o cartuchos quimicos recambiables.
Aprobación NIOSH conforme al tipo de filtro / cartucho utilizado.
Brinda protección respiratoria, ocular y facial.
Máscarilla interior en silicona provista de válvulas comple­tamente planas para brindar máximo confort.

Suspensión de 6 puntos con malla textil y correas ajusta­bles, para un sello perfecto a la cara.

Filtro de partículas P95 y P100.
Cartuchos Gases Ácidos y Vapores Orgánicos.

descl:
The Nelson Wrap Dispenser has been designed to help alleviate back stress by allowing the user to maintain a more natural position when wrapping pallets. With it original patented brake system the NWD-1 will ensure a tighter wrap, so there is less waste and makes it easier to stretch wrap various-shaped pallets. Your employees will thank you for the NWD-1 Nelson stretch wrap dispenser. The NWD-1 Nelson Wrap can be used anywhere you use standard 3" core stretch wrap film from warehouses, freight carriers, movers and more.   

It fits all standard 3" core wraps. Standard size in US
Please Note: The core can vary approx. 1/16 inch, depending on who manufactured the stretch wrap.  That is why the top end caps are made with the ribs in them, to compensate for slight variation in size.  
Lightweight aluminum just 4lbs.
Easy to use
Modular design makes for easy quick cylinder exchange; tension control for preferred stretch.
Designed to keep users in a natural position reducing injuries.
Made in the USA

descl:
Pencil Hardness Tester Gauge Tools with Load Weight 1000g 750g 500g 
Introduction:
Pencil Hardness Tester Paint Coating Films Scratches Tester with Load Weight 1000g 750g 500g Portable Pencil Hardness Gauge Testing Tools , Digital Pencil Hardness Tester Durometer Hardness Tester meter with Digital penetrometer Sclerometer Hardness Tester.
Application:
The instrument applies mechanical measurement. Keep three point touch the coating (two wheel, a pencil core), and a 45 degree angle between pencil and test surface. 
Push the instrument sliding,pencil draws the corresponding track in the coating. In the change of different pencil marks, the hardness value of the film can be determined.
Coating hardness is the necessary measurement for the performance of coatings. This instrument applied the pencil scratch method.
It is a fast and economical way to determine the film hardness using the drawing lead core or the pencil core.
The pencil scratch method for coating hardness testing is a common method in the world since the 1980s.
In China, this test method has also been promoted to the coating research and industrial production.
The instrument can be used both in laboratory, and on site.
Standard Accessories:
1. Pencil Hardness Tester

Construcción
Los transportadores de pluma telescópica MaxxReach están construidos con los más altos estándares, con una carcasa principal de 10 mm de grosor que proporciona uno de los transportadores más fuertes y robustos de su tipo en el mercado.

Luces del extremo de la pluma
En la parte delantera del transportador se instalan dos unidades LED de bajo consumo para iluminar directamente la zona de carga.

Barra de parada de la extensión
En la parte delantera del transportador de brazo telescópico se ha instalado una barra con resorte que actúa como tope de seguridad cuando el transportador se está extendiendo. Si se activa, el transportador de pluma detendrá todas sus funciones.

Tiras de cepillo
Se instalan tiras de cepillo entre cada etapa móvil del transportador para evitar que los residuos sean arrastrados al interior de la máquina durante la retracción.
